key_provisions_or_claims: Regrets lack of territorial dimension in the Industrial Action Plan for the automotive sector
Urges gradual, technology-neutral review of CO2 standards for cars, vans and heavy-duty vehicles
Welcomes planned European Connected and Autonomous Vehicle Alliance and asks regional input into an autonomous vehicle regulatory framework
Calls for increased just transition and cohesion funding and place-based solutions
Calls for upskilling/reskilling programmes and an implementation dialogue with automotive regions
annotation.summary_en: European Committee of the Regions resolution on the Commission's Industrial Action Plan for the automotive sector, urging stronger territorial and place-based measures, technology-neutral CO2 rules, just transition funding and skills programmes. It briefly welcomes a European Connected and Autonomous Vehicle Alliance and asks for regional input into autonomous vehicle regulation.
annotation.title_clean: Resolution on strengthening the territorial dimension in the implementation of the Industrial Action Plan for the European Automotive Sector
annotation.title_en: Resolution on strengthening the territorial dimension in the implementation of the Industrial Action Plan for the European Automotive Sector
